articles.summary: CALGARY, ALBERTA – November 3, 2025 – Greenfire Resources Ltd. (NYSE: GFR, TSX: GFR) ("Greenfire" or the "Company"), today announced its intention to undertake a rights offering of its common shares for gross proceeds of approximately C$300 million (the "Rights Offering").
articles.title: Greenfire Resources Announces Preliminary Results for Rights Offering
